# Eleda Stays React Website - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
This is a React-based website for Eleda Stays, featuring:
- Home page with hero section and featured content
- About page with company information and team
- Services page with offerings and packages
- Contact page with forms and business information
- Responsive design for all devices
- Modern UI components and styling

## Development Guidelines
- Use React functional components with hooks
- Implement responsive design with CSS Grid/Flexbox
- Follow accessibility best practices
- Use modern JavaScript (ES6+)
- Maintain clean, documented code
- Focus on user experience and performance

## Key Features Implemented
- Responsive navigation with React Router
- Hero sections with call-to-action buttons
- Feature cards and service grids
- Contact forms with validation
- Professional styling and layout
- Mobile-friendly responsive design

## Tech Stack
- React 18+ with functional components
- React Router for navigation
- Modern CSS with Grid/Flexbox layouts
- ES6+ JavaScript features
- NPM for package management
